description: Read the signed-in owner's own business assessment, for the business the account selects: ranges and codes OnHand worked out from the tools the owner lets it read, labelled "from the business's connected tools, worked out by OnHand" (not owner-approved content, which is "from the business"), with OnHand's labelled findings (free-fix suggestions, savings and revenue estimates), each with its range or why it is unknown, method, assumptions, source tools and freshness; stale findings are left out and counted. Answers only after an owner or admin turns on sharing with their AI assistants; otherwise returns sharing_off or not_available. Requires assessment:read (owner or admin). Read-only.
name: get_business_assessment
title: Get my business assessment
